candidate_relations.reason: Salivary gland tumors arise from glandular epithelium; the reference is mantle cell lymphoma, a B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. These are fundamentally different diagnostic entities despite both potentially presenting as palatal masses.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Salivary gland tumor is a distinct epithelial neoplasm, not a lymphoma

candidate_relations.reason: Fibromatosis involves fibroblastic proliferation and is unrelated to the lymphoid neoplasm mantle cell lymphoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Palatal fibromatosis is a fibrous/connective tissue proliferation, not a lymphoma

candidate_relations.reason: Torus palatinus is a developmental bony protuberance; it is entirely unrelated to mantle cell lymphoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Palatal torus is a benign bony exostosis, not a lymphoma

candidate_relations.reason: Lipoma arises from adipocytes and has no relation to the B-cell lymphoid neoplasm mantle cell lymphoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Lipoma is a benign adipose tissue tumor, not a lymphoma

candidate_relations.reason: Cherubism is a genetic disorder affecting the mandible/maxilla in children; it is entirely distinct from mantle cell lymphoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Cherubism is a hereditary fibro-osseous jaw condition, not a lymphoma

candidate_relations.reason: GPA is an ANCA-associated vasculitis; while it can involve the palate, it is a different diagnostic entity from mantle cell lymphoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis is a systemic vasculitis, not a lymphoma

candidate_relations.reason: Odontogenic or soft tissue myxoma is a distinct mesenchymal neoplasm unrelated to mantle cell lymphoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Myxoma is a mesenchymal tumor of myxoid stroma, not a lymphoma

candidate_relations.reason: Neurofibroma arises from Schwann cells/perineural fibroblasts and is a completely different entity from mantle cell lymphoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Neurofibroma is a peripheral nerve sheath tumor, not a lymphoma

candidate_relations.reason: Osteoma is a benign osseous neoplasm; it is unrelated to mantle cell lymphoma, a B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Osteoma is a benign bone-forming tumor, not a lymphoma
